Veteran’s Services
Veteran’s Service Officer: Jerry Seiner
The Charles Mix-Douglas County Veterans Service Officer will be out of the office until March 30, 2026
For assistance contact Either Veterans Service Officer
Dave Denson at 605-940-9622
Jerry Seiner at 605-481-1338
To schedule a DAV Van ride, contact Karen Krcil at the GIS Office at 487-6184 or 491-3176 (Cell)
Office Hours:
Douglas County Office: first and third Wednesday of each month: 8:00 a.m.- 4:30 p.m.
Charles Mix County Office: Monday & Tuesday 8:00 a.m.- 4:30 p.m. Second and fourth Wednesday of each month: 8:00 a.m.- Noon.
